component.name: GlobalProtect Tray
component.summary: External-browser tray client for GlobalProtect-compatible VPNs

description.p: GlobalProtect Tray controls globalprotect-openconnect from a lightweight desktop menu. Authentication runs in the user's regular browser, enabling password managers, WebAuthn, and security keys.
Portal and direct-gateway servers are supported, with automatic server type and legacy OpenSSL compatibility detection.
Initial distributable release with automatic server detection.
